text:
aina: quick thought — rather than a wide runtime shim that mutates every request, what about a narrow gateway-level shim that only does header translation + envelope unwrap/rewrap? smaller scope, easier to reason about, and easier to retire.

sam: sounds good. main snag: will this mask payload shape mismatches for internal services expecting the new contract? :thinking:

maria: we can instrument it. ingress shim emits migration_trace=X and increments a per-field mapping metric. build alerts for fields that map -> null or are dropped frequently.

aina: lifecycle proposal: 1) opt-in header mode (clients set X-RW-Compat: 1) 2) shim runs only for opt-ins 3) after 30 days with low error rates, flip to opt-out cohort for non-critical tenants 4) retire shim after 90 days of opt-outs. prevents permanent support burden.

tom: ops concerns — gateway CPU/memory if we JSON.parse full body on every request. Implementation should be lazy: only parse when header present or tenant-flagged. Add a perf circuit-breaker: if mapping latency > 20ms for 3s window, bypass shim and emit a fallback metric.

aina: implementation sketch (config-driven):

```
# gateway/compat-map.yaml
mappings:
  - id: legacy-envelope-unwrap
    when_header: X-RW-Compat
    translate:
      headers:
        - from: Legacy-Client-Version
          to: X-Client-Version
      body:
        unwrap_envelope: true
    timeout_ms: 15
    circuit_breaker: "failure_window_ms:3000,max_latency_ms:20"
```

maria: add tracing tags: shim.used=true, shim.mapping.count, shim.mapped_field_errors histogram. alerts: mapped_field_error_rate > 0.5% for 24h -> paging.

jen: comms side — we need a short migration playbook for customers: how to set header, sample SDK adapter, suggested rollout cadence, and retire dates. CS/marketing will want template emails. I can draft once you confirm timelines.

sam: note: some older SDKs don't expose easy header injection. we should ship tiny adapter snippets in each SDK repo (2-line integration) plus a curl example. also offer a tenant-level opt-in via console for customers that can't change clients.

deploy-bot: canary deployed ingress-compat v0.1 to prod-us-west (traffic: 1%). Logs available: /infra/ingress-shim/2026-03-23/

aina: action items — sam: SDK adapter snippets; maria: telemetry & alert rules; tom: circuit-breaker + perf budget; jen: comms + playbook draft. reconvene in one week to evaluate metrics and decide promote cadence. :thumbsup:
